description: Nowly brings calendars, tasks, notes, time and screenshots together on your Windows desktop for personal work, study and freelance projects. Start with local records, then connect external calendars or an AI service only when needed.

home.heading: Your personal workspace for Windows
home.lead: Keep today's schedule, your next task and quick notes in sight. Designed for personal work, study and freelance projects: organize in a normal window, view in wallpaper mode, and build a desktop from the modules that suit you.

scenes.title: Give your day a clear schedule
scenes.text: View events by month, week, day or list to plan classes, personal meetings and delivery dates. Start with a local calendar and add external sources when needed.

scenes.title: Decide what comes next
scenes.text: Use the four quadrants to weigh importance and urgency, and a board to track progress. Task due dates are dates only; create a calendar event for a timed reminder.

scenes.title: Keep information worth revisiting
scenes.text: Save ideas, study notes and project references as notes, pin frequently used entries, and browse them in a list or note board.

scenes.title: Keep what is on your screen
scenes.text: Start a screenshot from Nowly Bar, crop, annotate and obscure sensitive details, then save or copy the final PNG. History stays on your device.

differences.title: Your desktop is a viewing surface
differences.text: Wallpaper mode sits behind desktop icons, while Nowly Bar provides reminders and quick actions. Return to the foreground window to organize and edit.

differences.title: Start with the modules you need
differences.text: Add, move and resize modules on a 12×8 grid. Combine calendars, tasks, notes and time around your own routine.

differences.title: Connections are your choice
differences.text: Local records do not require an external account. Calendar authorization depends on release configuration and provider review; AI requires your chosen service and explicit data permissions.

home.privacyTitle: Local-first does not mean no network requests
home.privacyText: Structured records are mainly stored in local SQLite; attachments, sticker images and screenshots are separate local files. External calendar synchronization, update checks and optional AI contact the relevant services. Enabling external-calendar access for AI can send queried content to your selected service as context.

faq.question: Can I use it without connecting an account?
faq.answer: Yes. Add modules to create local events, tasks and notes, use the time module and access Windows desktop features. External calendars and AI are optional connections.

faq.question: Which systems are supported?
faq.answer: Nowly targets Windows 10 and Windows 11. Package types, processor architectures and dependencies depend on the specific release notes. A browser development preview does not replace the desktop app.

faq.question: What works offline?
faq.answer: Local records and desktop features remain usable. External sources show only previously cached content, which may be outdated. Synchronization, remote AI and update checks require a network connection.

faq.question: Will reminders work after closing the window?
faq.answer: The app still runs when hidden to the tray or returned to wallpaper mode. Calendar reminders, alarms and focus notifications require Nowly to remain running; exiting from the tray stops scheduling.

faq.question: Are Google and Microsoft connections always available?
faq.answer: No. Connection flows exist in the code, but releases need valid provider configuration and are subject to provider review, account permissions and service availability. This website does not claim verification or guarantee that every release enables connections.

faq.question: Does deleting local content delete remote originals?
faq.answer: Disconnecting an account or removing a subscription clears local connections and caches, not original remote calendars. Explicitly deleting a writable remote event is a separate operation that affects the provider's event. Check the source first.

download.title: Download Nowly
download.lead: Build your personal workspace on Windows 10 / 11. The download action opens the project's releases; versions and available files are defined by their release notes.

sections.title: Before installing
paragraphs: Check that your computer runs Windows 10 or Windows 11, and select a release file matching its processor architecture. The desktop interface depends on Microsoft Edge WebView2; follow the release instructions if installation or startup reports a missing dependency.
Do not infer that a particular installer format, digital signature or version has been published from this page. If no suitable file is available, check again later or contact support.

sections.title: Install and open for the first time
paragraphs: Download from the releases page, check the publisher and file source, and follow the installation method for that file. If Windows shows a security warning, verify the source first rather than disabling system protection.

Follow the in-app introduction when you first open Nowly. With no modules, a welcome screen appears. Choose Edit layout, then add your first module. A calendar, tasks, notes and time are a useful starting point; external account authorization is not required.

sections.title: Versions and updates
paragraphs: The About interface shows the running version and available release information. At startup, the app queries GitHub's latest release over HTTPS, compares versions and provides a release page and notes. This is not a promise of silent automatic installation.

A failed check does not block local use. Close unsaved edits, back up important data and read the release notes before updating. An upgrade from the old alarm format may clear old alarms and their scheduling notices once, requiring you to recreate them.

sections.title: Desktop app versus web preview
paragraphs: This website describes the product; it does not run your personal workspace in the browser. Wallpaper embedding, the system tray, global shortcuts and real screenshot file operations require the Windows desktop app.
The browser development preview uses separate browser storage. It does not prove that desktop data, system authorization or real file operations have been completed.

guide.title: Start with your first module
guide.lead: Build a local workspace first, then choose connections. This workflow suits personal work, class schedules and freelance projects without configuring AI first.

sections.title: 1. Add and arrange modules
paragraphs: In the foreground window, choose Edit layout and use Add module to select content. Move and resize modules on the 12×8 grid, then finish layout editing. The six built-in modules are calendar, task matrix, board, notes, time and stickers. Screenshots and AI are separate actions, not additional grid modules. If the grid is full, shrink or remove another module first.

When no modules exist, the welcome screen prompts you to add the first one. Removing a module is not the same as deleting records: removing the sticker module hides its artwork, which returns when added again. Do not use layout changes as data cleanup.

sections.title: 2. Plan today's events and tasks
paragraphs: Add a calendar and create a local event. Fill in start and end dates and times, check reminders, then save. Month, week, day and list views offer different ways to browse.

Add the task matrix or board and write down the next thing to do. Assign importance, urgency or a lane. A due date stores only a date; create a calendar event with a reminder if you need an alert at a specific time.

sections.title: 3. Save references and begin focusing
paragraphs: Add notes, give each record a title and edit its content. Save and pin it if needed. Rich-text attachments are separate local files with a 1 MiB limit per attachment; backing up only the database is not enough.

Add the time module and use the clock or timer icons in its header to switch between world clocks and focus sessions. Set a default focus duration, start, pause or resume. Switching back to clocks does not end the running timer.

sections.title: 4. Keep viewing access on your desktop
paragraphs: After organizing, use the wallpaper action at the top right to place Nowly behind desktop icons. Double-click the wallpaper or click the tray icon to return to the foreground window.

In notification settings, choose always-visible, notifications-only or disabled for Nowly Bar. Click its status area for reminders and its logo for the screenshot, screenshot history and AI menu. In notifications-only mode, hovering the top-edge strip reveals the Bar without opening a panel.

sections.title: 5. Connect external sources only when needed
paragraphs: Open calendar settings when you need subscriptions. Add an ICS source, or connect Google / Microsoft and select calendars when your release supports it. Check sync status and event sources; cached data is not necessarily live.
For AI, supply your own service address, Model ID and any required API Key, then explicitly choose allowed data scopes. Every local write plan needs a reviewed preview and button confirmation.

sections.title: 6. Save, back up and use safely
paragraphs: Event, task and note editors require an explicit save. If an error occurs, keep your draft, resolve it and verify the result. Some time and sticker settings save automatically, so closing settings does not necessarily discard changes.

Back up important information yourself. Fully exit Nowly before backing up its database and related files in the app data directory, and separately back up screenshots in the system Pictures directory. Do not send support a database containing account tokens or private attachments.

support.title: Support and troubleshooting
support.lead: Check the version, running mode and error message, then describe reproducible steps. A separate contact action on this page provides email support.

sections.title: Installation or startup fails
paragraphs: Record your Windows version, processor architecture, downloaded file name and Nowly version. Check release instructions and the WebView2 dependency. If an instance is already in the tray, try opening it there first.
If security software blocks the app, verify the file source and warning. Do not disable your entire security setup just to start it. Include a redacted error screenshot when contacting support.

sections.title: Modules, wallpaper and windows
paragraphs: If there is no content, check that modules have been added. Free grid space before adding more. For a failed module load, use its retry action rather than deleting the whole data directory.

If editing in wallpaper mode is difficult, double-click the wallpaper or click the tray icon to return to the foreground. Closing the window usually keeps a background process; use Exit Nowly in the tray to stop it completely.

sections.title: Reminders or shortcuts do not respond
paragraphs: Check that Nowly is running, Nowly Bar is not disabled and reminder settings were saved. Check Windows notification settings and whether Bar sounds are muted or the relevant scene is set to None. Timely ringing is not guaranteed during sleep or after a full exit.

Screenshot defaults to Ctrl+Alt+A and history to Ctrl+Alt+H. Check actual bindings and conflict messages in shortcut settings. The history shortcut requires Nowly Bar to be enabled; hiding a menu item does not disable its shortcut.

sections.title: Calendar synchronization or AI fails
paragraphs: Check your network, source status and last successful sync time. ICS needs accessible HTTPS subscription content. Account connections also depend on release configuration, provider review and account permissions. Do not repeatedly authorize to bypass provider restrictions.

For AI errors, check the service address, model, key and selected data permissions. Data or permission changes can invalidate an old plan; generate it again. If the execution result is uncertain, recover its status before submitting again.

sections.title: Submit a useful report
paragraphs: Include the app version, Windows version, expected and actual results, the shortest reproduction steps and redacted error text. Public issue channels are only for information safe to publish. Use email for private information, privacy questions or deletion requests.
Do not send passwords, OAuth tokens, API Keys, complete databases, full calendar exports or unredacted private screenshots. Support does not need your account login credentials.

privacy.title: Nowly Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: Original effective date: 2026-09-07. Last updated: 2026-10-15. This policy describes information handling in the Windows app, optional connections and public website.

sections.title: 1. Scope and developer
paragraphs: Nowly is provided by grey.wen (Wen Wang), Individual Developer, located in Changsha, Hunan, China. This policy covers personal records in the app, optional Google / Microsoft calendar connections, AI service connections and the public website.

The public website does not receive OAuth callbacks, login credentials, access or refresh tokens, or the app's calendar data. Account connection availability depends on release configuration and provider requirements. This policy does not indicate completed provider verification.

sections.title: 2. Local records, database and files
paragraphs: Structured content such as local events, tasks, note content, layout and settings, focus records, alarms, subscriptions and calendar caches is mainly stored in nowly.sqlite in the app data directory. Account identifiers and encrypted tokens are also stored locally.

Original attachments and sticker images are separate files in the app data directory, with references and metadata in the database. Final screenshot PNGs are in Nowly\Screenshots within the system Pictures directory; thumbnails are rebuildable local caches. The original full-screen background is used only during the current capture session. Original screenshot bytes are not stored in SQLite.

DPAPI protection for tokens does not automatically encrypt ordinary records, attachments, images or the database as a whole. Protect your Windows account and device, and back up both the database and related files.

sections.title: 3. Google data scopes and purposes
paragraphs: Only when you voluntarily connect Google Calendar does the app access account and calendar information within the permissions approved on the consent screen. openid provides the OpenID Connect subject identifier to establish and distinguish local account connections. email provides an account email label to distinguish accounts, not advertising profiles.

https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar allows reading authorized calendars, calendar lists and events, and supports explicitly user-initiated event creation, editing, moving, duration changes and deletion. The app uses this information to display and manage calendars you select. Actual writes are also limited by calendar permissions and supported event types.
Google Calendar data is processed and cached on the user's device, not stored on a developer-operated server. Calendar authorization tokens are not passed to AI services.

sections.title: 4. Microsoft and ICS sources
paragraphs: The Microsoft connection flow requests openid, email, offline_access and https://graph.microsoft.com/Calendars.ReadWrite for account identification, account labels, refresh tokens for continued authorization, and reading and user-initiated calendar event management respectively. Actual authorization is defined by the provider consent screen and release configuration.

ICS subscriptions store a source name, address, category, refresh settings and local event cache. Fetches use HTTPS; webcal addresses are converted to HTTPS. Private subscription addresses may function as access credentials and should not be shared publicly. ICS sources are read-only.

sections.title: 5. OAuth and transport protection
paragraphs: The app uses the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE (S256) and a random state value. Authorization responses return only to a temporary loopback listener on the device, which closes when finished. Google uses 127.0.0.1 and Microsoft uses localhost for the callback, both with a temporary port. Local callback HTTP does not mean remote transfers use HTTP.

Provider authorization, token exchange, identity lookup and calendar API requests use HTTPS (TLS) to the relevant provider endpoints. Access and refresh tokens are encrypted with Windows Data Protection API (DPAPI) before being written to the local database, are tied to the current Windows user, and are decrypted only when the backend needs an authorized request.

OAuth tokens are not intentionally logged, exposed to the app interface or sent to a developer-operated server. Keep Windows and the app updated. If a device is lost or shared, revoke provider authorization and clear local connections promptly.

sections.title: 6. Optional AI services and context
paragraphs: AI requires your service address, model and any required API Key, plus explicit permissions for local calendars, tasks or external calendars. No read permissions are enabled by default. Remote addresses must use HTTPS; a local loopback service may use HTTP. API Keys are encrypted with DPAPI before local storage.

When processing a request, the selected service may receive your input, recent conversation, current time and timezone, week-start setting, permissions, and calendar or task records queried within your allowed scopes. Revising a plan may also send the previous draft. With external-calendar permission enabled, cached Google, Microsoft or ICS event content queried within that permission scope may be sent to the selected AI service as request context, including returned fields such as title, source, event identifier, start and end times, all-day status and last synchronization time. Local caching does not mean data can never leave the device.

The assistant can only propose local calendar and task changes, executed after your button confirmation. External calendars are read-only in the assistant. Plans and undo information are retained locally for approximately seven days, with expired records cleaned by the app. Third-party services have their own retention, processing and security policies. Do not send sensitive content to untrusted services; records from a disabled permission scope are not supplied through queries for that scope.

sections.title: 7. Sharing, advertising and Google Limited Use
paragraphs: We do not sell Google user data, use it for advertising, or transfer it to third parties except as necessary to provide a user-requested feature, comply with law, or protect users and the service. Optional AI requests require user configuration and selection of data scopes; they do not mean all calendars are shared by default.

Google user data is not used to train, develop or improve generalized artificial intelligence or machine learning models. When Google data is involved, select only processing arrangements and services consistent with these restrictions. This policy does not claim control over every action of an arbitrary third-party provider.

Nowly's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. A separate reference link to that Google policy is provided on this page.

sections.title: 8. Update checks and website access logs
paragraphs: At startup, the app requests the GitHub Releases API over HTTPS for the latest version and release notes. This check does not upload local calendar, task or note content, but GitHub can receive the request's IP address and normal request metadata.

The current configuration does not enable product analytics or crash reporting, and the public website does not embed analytics tracking. Hosting and network infrastructure may still log IP addresses, request paths, times, browser identifiers and response status for operation and security. No analytics tracking does not mean no server access logs.

When you contact support, the email address, description and attachments you voluntarily send may be used to handle your request. Redact them first; do not send credentials or full backups. This policy must be updated before introducing analytics or crash reporting.

sections.title: 9. Retention, disconnection and deletion
paragraphs: Personal records and files remain on your device until you delete or clean them up. Disconnecting a calendar account removes local OAuth tokens, the account connection, subscription settings and associated event caches. Removing one subscription removes its local cache, not authorization for the entire account.

Disconnection does not automatically delete original calendars, events or account information in Google or Microsoft. You can separately revoke authorization through the provider's account security controls. Deleting a screenshot history entry deletes its local PNG and thumbnail, but does not recover copies already copied or shared.

To ask about or request deletion of other information actually held by the developer, use email support and describe the scope. We will reasonably verify the requester and respond according to the applicable process. If no server-side account or calendar data exists, the response will explain that.

sections.title: 10. Choices, contact and policy changes
paragraphs: You can avoid external connections, change AI read permissions, clear a saved AI Key, delete local records or disconnect calendar accounts. Clearing a key or withdrawing permissions does not retract context already sent to a third party; contact that provider about its copies.

Contact the developer through support email for privacy, access or deletion questions. When the product, law or provider requirements change, a revised policy will be published here with an updated date. The original effective date remains 2026-09-07; this update is dated 2026-10-15.

terms.title: Nowly Terms of Service
terms.lead: Original effective date: 2026-09-07. Last updated: 2026-10-15. These terms retain the existing service terms and apply to the product and related connection features.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By using Nowly, you acknowledge these terms, the Privacy Policy and applicable third-party platform terms. If you do not agree, do not use the affected features.

sections.title: 2. Permitted use
paragraphs: Nowly supports personal productivity, calendar viewing and user-initiated event operations. Connect only accounts you are authorized to access. Do not bypass authorization, misuse permissions or interfere with the service.

Person names in local task fields are organizational information, not remote collaboration accounts, invitations or sharing permissions. AI is an optional aid, not a substitute for checking your intent and the proposed content.

sections.title: 3. Third-party services
paragraphs: Google Calendar, Microsoft calendars, ICS sources and your chosen AI service are provided by their respective third parties. Your platform account, original content, service availability and platform rules remain governed by you and that provider. Nowly does not change ownership or control of original platform data.

Connections are subject to release configuration, provider review, account permissions and service limitations. Explicitly saving or deleting a writable calendar event can modify a remote original; disconnecting or deleting local caches does not delete remote originals.

sections.title: 4. Your responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for securing your device, Windows account and third-party accounts, and confirming that calendar operations through Nowly match your intentions and authority. Assess inputs and allowed query context before sending them to an AI service.

Check personal information before saving or sharing screenshots, and keep appropriate backups of important records and related local files. Closing the window does not necessarily stop the app or its reminders.

sections.title: 5. Availability and disclaimer
paragraphs: The product depends on your device, network and third-party platforms. Continuous availability, immediate synchronization and compatibility with every event type are not guaranteed. Keep appropriate backups of important information.

Sleep, a full exit, system restrictions, expired authorization or network failures may affect reminders, synchronization and connections. AI results may be wrong and require preview review. Undo depends on retention and subsequent data changes; not every action is guaranteed to be reversible.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Nowly, its branding, pages and related materials are protected by applicable law. These terms do not grant rights to copy, distribute or reverse engineer protected materials except where the law or a separate license permits it.
These terms do not change ownership of your original platform data or replace an applicable separate software license or third-party material license.

sections.title: 7. Changes and contact
paragraphs: These terms may be updated, with the revised version published here. Send questions through support email. The original effective date is 2026-09-07; this update is dated 2026-10-15.

data-deletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
data-deletion.lead: Original policy effective date: 2026-09-07. Last updated: 2026-10-15. Distinguish local records, account connections, screenshot files and third-party originals before choosing what to remove.

sections.title: 1. Disconnect an external calendar account
paragraphs: In subscription management within calendar settings, find the connected Google or Microsoft account, choose Disconnect and confirm. The app removes the local account connection, OAuth access and refresh tokens, related subscription settings and associated event caches.

To revoke provider authorization too, remove Nowly in Google or Microsoft's account permission controls. Provider revocation and local cleanup are separate actions. If you cannot access the device, revoke authorization through the provider first.

sections.title: 2. Remove subscriptions and personal records
paragraphs: Removing one ICS or account-calendar subscription clears its local subscription and cache, not the source's original calendar. For local events, tasks or notes, use the corresponding editor's delete action and confirmation. Check the record source first.

Deleting a writable external event asks the provider to delete it; this is not local cache cleanup. Removing a module does not delete records either. Rich-text attachments may be shared by several records, so deleting one note does not prove that all related files were immediately removed.

sections.title: 3. Delete screenshots and copies
paragraphs: Open screenshot history in Nowly Bar, choose Delete on an entry and confirm. This deletes its final PNG and local thumbnail cache. Open folder to check Nowly\Screenshots in the system Pictures directory; its location follows any system redirection.
Canceling a capture creates no archive. Copies placed in the clipboard, saved elsewhere, backed up or shared need separate cleanup. Deleting history does not recover external copies.

sections.title: 4. Clear AI access and all local data
paragraphs: In AI settings, deselect unwanted read scopes, choose to clear the saved API Key and save. If the key may be compromised, revoke or rotate it at the provider too. This does not delete inputs or context the service already received.

To remove all local data, back up anything you need, fully exit Nowly, then identify and remove its database, attachments and sticker resources in the app data directory. Handle the screenshot directory and your own backups separately. Do not delete other apps' directories or assume uninstalling removes every file. Contact support first if you cannot identify the correct path.
Assistant operation and undo records are cleaned locally on an approximately seven-day retention cycle. Closing the panel or clearing a key does not immediately delete every operation record.

sections.title: 5. Request deletion of developer-held information
paragraphs: Use the email support action on this page. Include Nowly, enough information to identify the relevant contact or connection, and the scope of your request. Do not send passwords, OAuth tokens, API Keys, complete databases or full calendar exports.

The developer will reasonably verify the requester and respond according to the applicable process. If no server-side account or calendar storage exists, the response will explain that and guide local cleanup. Files on your device generally require action on that device.

sections.title: 6. Providers still manage original data
paragraphs: Disconnecting Nowly does not automatically delete original Google / Microsoft calendars, events or account information, or data held by ICS publishers or AI services. Use each provider's data management or deletion process.

calendar.title: Calendar: give your plans a time
calendar.lead: Start with local events and browse by month, week, day or list. Add external sources when needed, and check sources and write permissions before acting.

sections.title: Views and navigation
paragraphs: Add the calendar module, then use the header icons for month, week, day or list views. Navigate backward, forward or to Today. Date details show that day's schedule; more-events indicators reveal entries that do not fit in the current view.

Calendar settings adjust display formats, week start and related options. Source timezones affect display. Check your computer's local time and event dates, particularly for events crossing days or timezones.

sections.title: Create and save events
paragraphs: Use the add action or a date's create action. Fill in the title, start and end dates and times, all-day option, category and notes, then review and save. Add reminder offsets when needed, either at the start or beforehand.

The time picker accepts any minute from 00 to 59. Typing, presets and Now change only the draft; Confirm or Enter submits it. Esc or an outside click cancels unconfirmed edits. Required times and invalid start/end ranges cannot be saved.

sections.title: Move, resize and repeat
paragraphs: In supported views, drag writable events to new dates or times, or adjust their duration. You can also edit in the dialog. Read-only sources cannot be written through dragging.

Local recurring events support daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or custom rules. When editing or deleting a recurrence, choose the scope offered by the dialog. Changing the start or rule may affect later events. Remote recurrence types and scope support differ; not every provider event is guaranteed compatible.

sections.title: Reminders need the app running
paragraphs: After saving reminders, keep Nowly running in the foreground, wallpaper mode or tray. Nowly Bar and notification settings control reminder display and sounds. System settings or sleep affect timeliness; a full exit stops scheduling.
Successful synchronization does not guarantee an on-time reminder. Keep an appropriate backup reminder method for important commitments.

sections.title: External sources and caches
paragraphs: Add ICS in subscription management within calendar settings, or connect Google / Microsoft and select calendars when the release allows it. Refresh with the sync action and check the last successful sync and error state. Failed synchronization preserves the last successful cache.

ICS is read-only. Account-calendar writability depends on authorization scopes, calendar roles and event compatibility. Check the target calendar before creating a remote event; saving, moving, resizing or deleting may modify its remote original. All external calendars are read-only for the AI assistant even when the calendar interface allows writes.

tasks.title: Tasks: choose priorities and track progress
tasks.lead: Use four quadrants for importance and urgency, and a board for your workflow. Both views use the local task workspace, with visibility relationships controlled by task linking settings.

sections.title: Create your next action
paragraphs: Use a new-task action in the matrix or board, enter a title and description, and optionally set importance and urgency, a due date, lane and tags. Save explicitly. The matrix entry point defaults to important and urgent; adjust it to reflect the actual task.
A task due date contains only a date, not a precise time or alarm. Create a calendar event for a timed reminder. Do not assume a due date automatically generates an alert.

sections.title: Four quadrants and board lanes
paragraphs: The matrix groups tasks as important and urgent, important but not urgent, urgent but not important, and neither. Reclassify by dragging or editing. On the board, add or edit lanes and move cards to track progress.

Whether a task appears in both views depends on linking settings and view membership. Tasks without a quadrant priority do not appear in the matrix. If a task is missing, check membership, priority and filters before creating a duplicate.

sections.title: Tags, person names and completion
paragraphs: Choose existing tags and person names in the task editor and manage these fields in task settings. Person names are local organizational fields: they do not send invitations or represent shared accounts or remote collaboration.

Check the relationship between completion status and the configured completion lane before marking a task complete. When linking is enabled, changes to the same task appear in its linked view. Do not treat another view of a record as an independent copy to delete.

sections.title: Descriptions, attachments and save errors
paragraphs: Descriptions use a rich-text editor. Original attachments are separate local files, limited to 1 MiB each. Supported images and common documents are defined by the file picker; restricted files cannot be imported or run.
Keep edits and retry if saving fails. Deletion requires confirmation, and closing with unsaved edits prompts you. Back up both the database and attachments to preserve tasks fully.

sections.title: Optional AI assistance
paragraphs: After configuring AI and allowing local-task access, use natural language to query or propose creation, updates and deletion. Review the exact records, dates, lanes and before/after details before confirming execution.
The assistant does not administer board configuration, support mixed calendar/task write batches or execute arbitrary code. Undo is limited by later changes and record validity.

notes.title: Notes: keep information for next time
notes.lead: Capture ideas, study points and project references. Organize with titles, colors, icons and pins without turning every thought into a task.

sections.title: Create and edit
paragraphs: Add the notes module and use its new-note action. Enter a title and rich-text content, choose a color, icon or pin, then save. Click a note again to edit it; closing with unsaved content prompts you.
Deleting a note requires explicit confirmation. Save errors remain in the editor so you can resolve them and retry. Closing a dialog is not a substitute for saving.

sections.title: List, note board and manager
paragraphs: Choose list or note-board display in note settings; the selection applies immediately. Pin frequently used references. The note manager lets you browse entries, open them for editing and create new ones.
The module is a viewing entry point. Changing layout or display does not delete notes. Use a record's delete action for data cleanup.

sections.title: Rich text and attachments
paragraphs: Use the editor for formatted content and supported images or documents. Each attachment is limited to 1 MiB; the picker and validation messages define supported formats. This is not an unlimited file library.

Content and attachment references are stored in SQLite, while attachment bytes live in the app data directory's attachment folder. Events, tasks and notes may share attachments. Preserve them together for backups or migration; deleting one record does not guarantee immediate deletion of a shared attachment.

sections.title: Artwork versus notes
paragraphs: For freely arranged text and images, add the separate sticker module. Its 800×600 logical canvas supports up to 50 objects. Images may be PNG, JPEG or static WebP, up to 10 MiB each and subject to dimension checks.

Stickers support moving, resizing, rotation, layers, locking and opacity; text supports styling, size and alignment. Changes save automatically after about 500 milliseconds of inactivity, or immediately when dragging ends. Failed saves preserve the draft for retry. Wallpaper and layout-editing modes are read-only; removing the module only hides the artwork.

sections.title: Privacy and retention
paragraphs: Notes and images stay on your device but are not automatically all encrypted by being local-first. Protect your Windows account and back up regularly. The current assistant permissions cover calendars, tasks and external calendars, not reading the note library or writing notes. Text you deliberately paste into an AI message is still sent to the selected service.

time.title: Time: world clocks, focus and alarms
time.lead: One time module, two viewing modes. Clocks and focus share a module position; alarms schedule independently, but all require the app to remain running.

sections.title: Switch display and configure
paragraphs: Choose Time in Add module. Clock and timer icons in the header switch world clocks and focus sessions; the module title remains Time. World clocks, Focus and Alarms tabs in settings change configuration only, not the module display.
Switching display does not stop an active focus session. A bottom status bar in clock view takes you back to focus. Focus statistics is available in the header only while focus is displayed.

sections.title: World clocks
paragraphs: Set a name, timezone and order for each city, or remove it when no longer needed. All cities share display mode, horizontal or vertical layout, hour format and whether to show seconds, city, date and time difference.

Use automatic sizing or a manual 32–160px clock size, with a separate date toggle. Optional time differences compare each city with the computer's local time; there is no separate time-difference lookup panel. Valid changes save automatically; closing settings does not discard them.

sections.title: Focus sessions and statistics
paragraphs: Set a default focus duration from 1 to 720 minutes. Start, pause, resume or end a session and use full-screen focus when helpful. In the desktop app, the main page, full-screen surface and Nowly Bar share one global timer state.
Open focus statistics to view session records. Focus settings only set the default duration and do not display records. Check the interface for the actual completed or ended state.

sections.title: Date-free alarms
paragraphs: Add a title and local time in alarm settings. New alarms default to 09:00, repeating Monday through Friday. Creation needs confirmation; existing alarms expand inside their list entry and valid edits save automatically. Deletion still needs confirmation.

Alarms have no calendar-date selector. With repetition off, an alarm rings at the next specified local time once and becomes disabled after handling. Repeating alarms require selected weekdays; an empty selection cannot be saved. Any minute is supported. Confirm or Enter submits time, while Esc or an outside click cancels the draft.

sections.title: Ringing, snooze and running requirements
paragraphs: Nowly Bar lets you acknowledge an alarm or snooze it for five minutes. Enabled alarm audio plays for at most one minute per alert, then stops while the pending notice remains. Bar sound settings let you choose scenes, preview sounds, change volume or mute them.

Keep Nowly running in the background or tray. After restart or resume from sleep, missed alarms produce one summary rather than individual replayed alerts. Removing the time module does not disable alarms; a full exit leaves no Windows scheduling task. Upgrading the old date-based format may clear old alarms and related notices once, so check after updating.

desktop.title: Desktop, layout and Nowly Bar
desktop.lead: Organize in the foreground and view on the desktop. Wallpaper, tray and top-edge access are different ways to use the same Windows app.

sections.title: Normal window and wallpaper mode
paragraphs: Use the wallpaper action at the top right to embed Nowly behind desktop icons. Double-click the wallpaper or click the tray icon to return to the foreground. Within the same process, the previous window position, size and maximized state are restored.
Settings can hide navigation and module headers in wallpaper mode. Return to the foreground when those controls are needed. This option does not change module data or hide the independent Nowly Bar.

sections.title: Layout and appearance
paragraphs: Enter Edit layout to add, move and resize modules on the 12×8 grid. If space runs out, shrink or remove another module first. Content scrolls inside modules instead of extending the whole page indefinitely.

Settings offer compact, balanced or comfortable density, icon style, language and background-related options. Density mainly changes spacing. Language initially follows the system and can switch between Simplified Chinese and English, including screenshots and the Bar.

sections.title: Closing, tray and startup
paragraphs: With the wallpaper preference enabled, closing the foreground window returns it to wallpaper mode; otherwise it hides to the tray. Closing is not exiting, and reminders and timers rely on the remaining process. Exit Nowly in the tray terminates the app.
Autostart is optional for the current Windows user. Turning it off and saving removes that user's startup entry. System restrictions or manual changes to the entry may affect startup behavior.

sections.title: Top-edge status access
paragraphs: Nowly Bar's status area is for reminders and status, while the logo opens the feature menu, not AI directly. Reminder, menu, AI and screenshot history panels are mutually exclusive. Click the status area or press Enter / Space to open reminders; Esc closes panels.

Choose always-visible, notifications-only or disabled in notification settings. With notifications-only and no pending notice, a top-edge strip appears. Hovering reveals the full Bar; clicking opens a panel. Pending notices, open panels and input focus keep full access visible. Capture sessions suppress the entry.

sections.title: Menu, screenshots and AI
paragraphs: The menu includes screenshot, screenshot history and AI assistant by default. In notification settings, use Nowly Bar's feature-menu settings to show, hide and reorder items. If all are hidden, the menu explains how to enable them again. Hiding an item does not change its shortcut.

Change screenshot and history shortcuts in shortcut settings; conflicts are reported. No default global AI shortcut is promised here. Enable the Bar first if it is disabled, especially when opening history.

capture.title: Screenshots: crop, annotate and keep local history
capture.lead: Capture information from Nowly Bar or a global shortcut. Only the final result is archived, and both saving and copying leave a local PNG.

sections.title: Start a capture
paragraphs: Click the logo in Nowly Bar and choose Screenshot, or use the default Ctrl+Alt+A. History defaults to Ctrl+Alt+H. Change bindings in shortcut settings; use the actual configured combination and choose another if it conflicts.

Full capture functionality needs the Windows desktop app. Hiding a menu item does not disable its shortcut; history requires Nowly Bar to be enabled. On startup failure, read the error and retry rather than repeatedly clicking.

sections.title: Crop and annotate
paragraphs: Select a region, then use rectangle, ellipse, arrow, pen, text and mosaic tools as needed, with undo and redo. Zoom in before saving to verify sensitive information is obscured and unwanted windows are excluded.

Scrolling capture is available only when the current selection and session state support it. Disabled controls explain why. Different apps, movement and dynamic content can affect stitching; inspect the final image. Complete capture of every window is not guaranteed.

sections.title: Save or copy the final PNG
paragraphs: Save writes directly to Nowly\Screenshots within the system Pictures directory, without a Save As dialog. Copy image and finish also saves the final PNG before writing to the image clipboard. The location follows system Pictures directory redirection.

Only the cropped, annotated and mosaicked final result is saved. Canceling creates no record. Archive failure keeps the edit and does not copy. If saving succeeds but clipboard writing fails, retry without duplicating the archive of the same final image.

sections.title: Browse and delete history
paragraphs: Use the menu or history shortcut to open history within the Bar. View complete thumbnails, copy images or open the folder. Copying from history creates no new entry. Records remain until deleted.

Deletion needs confirmation and removes both the corresponding local PNG and thumbnail cache. Esc cancels an active deletion confirmation first, otherwise collapses the panel. The close control or an outside click also collapses it. Shared, copied or backed-up copies require separate cleanup.

sections.title: Image storage and privacy
paragraphs: Final PNGs are local files, not original image bytes in SQLite. Thumbnail caches can be rebuilt, and the original full-screen background is used only during the current session. History is not an automatically cleared temporary directory.

Screenshots may contain personal information or content from other apps. Check before sharing. Local storage does not mean an image is encrypted, or that copies placed in another app remain under Nowly's control.

connections.title: Connect calendars and optional AI
connections.lead: Connect only what you need. Account authorization and AI setup are different workflows with different permissions, data transfers and write limits.

sections.title: Understand availability first
paragraphs: Local events, tasks and notes do not require provider connections. Google / Microsoft flows exist in the app, but public availability depends on the release's configuration, provider review, account policies and network. This website does not claim verification.

If a release lacks provider configuration or the authorization page rejects the request, do not send passwords to the developer or bypass provider restrictions. Use local calendars, or an ICS subscription where you are authorized to access it.

sections.title: Add a read-only ICS subscription
paragraphs: Open subscription management in calendar settings, choose ICS, enter a source name and valid subscription address, optionally choose a category and refresh interval, then save. Addresses must use HTTPS or webcal, which is converted to HTTPS. There is a limit of 50 subscription sources.

The device fetches and caches ICS directly without writing back to its publisher. Private subscription URLs may grant access and should not be public. Check status and the last successful sync time. A network failure may leave an older cache visible rather than current content.

sections.title: Connect Google or Microsoft
paragraphs: In a release where the provider is available, select it and choose Connect. Sign in and review consent in the system browser. The app completes authorization with PKCE, random state and a temporary device loopback callback. The website does not collect passwords or callbacks.

Back in the app, select the account and calendars to subscribe to. The same remote calendar under the same account is not added twice. OAuth tokens are DPAPI-encrypted locally. Permissions include account identification and email, Google's calendar scope, and Microsoft's offline_access and Calendars.ReadWrite. See the Privacy Policy for full scopes and purposes.

sections.title: Sync, write and disconnect
paragraphs: Set a refresh interval and check results through manual synchronization. Failure preserves the last successful cache. Immediate synchronization and universal event compatibility are not guaranteed. Account scopes and calendar roles determine writability, and individual records can still be read-only.

Creating, editing, moving, resizing or deleting in a writable source requests an actual provider operation. Check the target source first. Disconnecting removes local tokens, connections, subscriptions and caches, not remote originals. Revoke provider authorization separately if needed.

sections.title: Configure an optional AI service
paragraphs: Open AI assistant settings, enter the service address, Model ID and any required API Key, select allowed local-calendar, task or external-calendar scopes, then save and check the result. The app can detect compatible OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Gemini or Ollama protocols, but arbitrary models and proxies are not guaranteed compatible.

Remote services must use HTTPS; a local loopback service may use HTTP. Keys are DPAPI-encrypted locally, and a blank field does not reveal the saved key. Select Clear saved Key and save to remove it. Connection detection during saving does not send business records; actual requests send input, recent conversation and queries within permitted scopes.

External-calendar access may send Google / Microsoft event content to the selected service. It is not enabled by default or required just to use calendars. Review the service's data policy first. Google data must not be used for generalized model training; do not select processing that conflicts with that restriction.

sections.title: Review the plan, then confirm
paragraphs: Describe a local calendar or task query, creation, update or deletion. The assistant queries existing records, may ask you to clarify duplicate titles, dates or times, and produces a before/after preview. After editing or selecting plan items, regenerate a valid preview before using the confirmation button. The model cannot execute by itself.

Date queries cover at most 90 days, with up to 200 returned records; narrow the range if results are truncated. Write batches contain 1–20 distinct targets in one domain, not mixed calendar and task writes. External calendars are always read-only. Notes, modules, themes, arbitrary code and board configuration are outside its write scope.

For recurrence, only one explicitly queried occurrence of a local event can be changed or deleted. The assistant cannot create or change recurrence rules or entire series, or change reminder offsets for a single recurring occurrence. Task due dates are dates only.

sections.title: Cancel, undo and recover
paragraphs: Cancel an unconfirmed plan if it is unwanted. Stopping processing does not commit writes. Data, permissions or related settings changing can invalidate a preview; query or generate again. If the execution result is uncertain, recover its status before confirming again.

Local history shows today, three-day or seven-day records. Undo is available only within retention and when affected data has not subsequently changed. It does not restore the whole database or overwrite conflicts. Clearing an API Key or closing the panel does not retract content already sent to third parties.
